Initial lab tests reveal an imbalance in key hormonal levels associated with the Glianorex. To further investigate the root cause, the physician decides to use advanced neuroimaging. Which combination of imaging modalities will provide the most comprehensive insight into both the structural and functional abnormalities of the Glianorex, specifically focusing on hormone synthesis, receptor interactions, and cellular density abnormalities?

options.C: Magnetic Resonance Glio-Imaging (MRGI) and Single-Photon Emission Computed Tomography carried with Glio-Specific Radiotracers (SPECT-GSR)
options.D: Gliotropic Resonance Spectroscopy (GRS) and Positron Emission Tomography integrated with Neuro-Glianorex Scanning (PET-NGS)
options.F: I don't know or cannot answer
